page_title: Rajendra P N - Release & Deployment Engineer
headline: Release & Deployment Engineer | Azure DevOps | AWS
summary_html: Release & Deployment Engineer with 10+ years of experience in software delivery, DevOps, and production support. Coordinates releases across development, test, staging, and production, combining Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Git, and deployment automation with environment readiness, ServiceNow change requests, CAB coordination, ITIL processes, validation, and rollback planning. Automates operational tasks with PowerShell, Python, and Bash; troubleshoots deployment failures and supports incident recovery. Partners with Development, QA, Infrastructure, Security, and business stakeholders to deliver controlled releases with clear communication and operational evidence.

achievements.text: Supported ServiceNow change requests and CAB approval coordination, aligning risk assessments, implementation plans, validation evidence, and rollback procedures with ITIL processes.
Built reusable CI/CD workflows and Python, PowerShell, and Bash utilities for repeatable deployments and operational checks.
Investigated deployment failures, coordinated incident response, and converted recurring issues into documented fixes and improved release procedures.
